description: This file defines the RetrieveFeatureDefinitionStrategy class, which handles the RetrieveFeatureDefinition command within a persistence context for managing 'things' features. It extracts feature definitions from 'Thing' objects and constructs responses or errors accordingly.

classes.name: RetrieveFeatureDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: Implements the command strategy to retrieve feature definitions from a Thing object, constructing appropriate responses or error results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the retrieval operation, extracting the feature and constructing a result with the feature definition or an error if not found.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts the specified feature from the Thing object, returning an Optional containing the feature if present.

methods.name: getFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Builds a result containing the feature definition response, or an error if the definition is not found.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous EntityTag associated with the command, typically to facilitate entity state comparison.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next EntityTag based on the current or new entity, indicating changes in the feature definition.
